blocks.raw: > Secure Internet Access Enterprise (SIA) leverages real-time Akamai Cloud Security Intelligence and Akamai’s proven, globally distributed, recursive DNS platform to identify and block targeted threats such as malware, ransomware, DNS data exfiltration, and phishing. Akamai’s cloud portal lets security teams centrally manage and enforce unified security and acceptable use policies for all employees in minutes.
